{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Normal| trainername=Paul| pokemonname=Ursaring| jtrainername=シンジ| jpokemonname=リングマ| tmtrainername=Shinji| tmpokemonname=Ringuma| image=[[File:Paul Ursaring.png|250px]] | caption=Paul's Ursaring | location=[[Bewilder Forest]] | ability={{a|Guts}}| epnum=DP006| epname=Different Strokes for Different Blokes| prevonum=217| current=With [[Reggie]] in [[Veilstone City]]| java1= [[Unshō Ishizuka]]| }} '''Paul's Ursaring''' (Japanese: '''シンジのリングマ''' ''Shinji's Ringuma'') is the fifth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that was shown to be owned by [[Paul]]. ==History== [[File:Paul Ursaring Guts.png|thumb|250px|left|{{a|Guts}} activated]] {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} had gotten lost in [[Bewilder Forest]] in ''[[DP006|Different Strokes for Different Blokes]]''. While looking for a way out, they encountered an angry {{p|Ursaring}}, which started chasing them. After getting out of the forest, the group encountered [[Paul]]. Using his {{AP|Chimchar}}, Paul weakened Ursaring and {{pkmn2|caught}} it. Afterwards, Paul used his [[Pokédex]] to scan its attacks, and then decided to keep it. In ''[[DP040|Top-Down Training!]]'', Paul used Ursaring to save Chimchar from {{TRT}}. In ''[[DP051|Glory Blaze!]]'', Paul used it in training Chimchar. In ''[[DP081|Chim - Charred!]]'', Ursaring was used in a battle against Chimchar, who, by that point, had come under Ash's ownership. With its brute strength and power, it almost defeated Chimchar when he activated his {{a|Blaze}} [[Ability]]. However, after Chimchar lost control of Blaze, he defeated Ursaring. Ursaring was used against [[Brandon's legendary giants#Regice|Brandon's Regice]] in ''[[DP128|A Pyramiding Rage!]]''. After a clash of its {{m|Hammer Arm}} and Regice's {{m|Focus Punch}}, it attacked Ursaring with {{m|Zap Cannon}}, which paralyzed it. {{an|Brandon}} then recalled Regice and sent out his {{DL|Brandon's legendary giants|Regirock}}. Paul gave up on Ursaring and did not command it to attack, resulting in it getting knocked out by Regirock's {{m|Stone Edge}}. [[File:Ash Chimchar vs Paul Ursaring.png|thumb|250px|Ursaring battling Chimchar]] In ''[[DP132|Evolving Strategies!]]'' Ursaring was used in the [[Full Battle]] against Ash as Paul's sixth Pokémon, which took place at [[Lake Acuity]]. With the power of {{m|Bulk Up}}, it easily defeated [[Ash's Buizel]] and {{AP|Staraptor}} before being recalled. During the battle with {{AP|Pikachu}}, it got paralyzed by Pikachu's {{a|Static}} Ability. However, this, in turn, activated its {{a|Guts}} Ability, giving the {{pkmn|category|Hibernator Pokémon}} the power that it needed ultimately take Pikachu down. Ursaring was eventually brought down by Chimchar once again after being attacked with a Flamethrower. In ''[[DP184|Casting a Paul on Barry!]]'', Ursaring was sent out to battle against [[Barry's Empoleon]] in the third round of the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. However, {{an|Barry}} [[Recall|replaced]] Empoleon with his {{p|Hitmonlee}}. During a very close match between the two, Ursaring was {{status|burned}} by Hitmonlee's {{m|Blaze Kick}}, activating Ursaring's Guts Ability again, giving Ursaring enough power to defeat Hitmonlee. Ursaring fought against Barry's Empoleon again, but after having a {{m|Focus Blast}} fired back to it, Paul recalled it. In ''[[DP188|Battling a Thaw in Relations!]]'', Ursaring was at [[Reggie]]'s house along with {{TP|Paul|Torterra}}, {{p|Weavile}}, and {{TP|Paul|Honchkrow}}. It was unhappy to hear that Paul had lost in the quarterfinals of the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. {{left clear}} ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Paul and Ursaring.png|thumb|220px|Ursaring and Paul]] [[File:Paul Ursaring hostility.png|thumb|left|220px|Ursaring's hostile nature]] Paul's Ursaring is known for its aggressive and intimidating nature. It's consistently hostile, often roaring fiercely upon being released from its Poké Ball, which causes others to fear it. Paul seems to approve of this behavior, believing it brings out Ursaring's full strength. Ursaring is a tenacious and resilient fighter with a bold, unyielding spirit. Its Guts Ability amplifies its fierce determination, making it a relentless force in battle. This Pokémon thrives under pressure, showcasing its grit by single-handedly overpowering multiple opponents, like when it dominated half of Ash’s team during their intense Full Battle at Lake Acuity, shrugging off powerful attacks and pushing through to challenge Ash’s Chimchar until the very end. Ursaring’s endurance shines through in prolonged fights, such as its hard-fought victory over Barry’s Hitmonlee, where it stood firm against a barrage of super-effective moves and still pressed on to face Barry’s Empoleon with unwavering resolve. {{-}} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|normal||Paul Ursaring {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Hyper Beam|1=Focus Blast|2=Hammer Arm}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Hyper Beam|1=Focus Blast|2=Hammer Arm}}|image2=Paul Ursaring {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Secret Power|1=Bulk Up|2=Slash}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Secret Power|1=Bulk Up|2=Slash}}}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|DP006|Different Strokes for Different Blokes}} {{anmov|fighting|Focus Blast|DP051|Glory Blaze!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|fighting|Hammer Arm|DP051|Glory Blaze!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|normal|Secret Power|DP081|Chim - Charred!}} {{anmov|fighting|Bulk Up|DP132|Evolving Strategies!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|normal|Slash|DP132|Evolving Strategies!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ==Artwork== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{normal color dark}}; background: #{{normal color}}; font-size: 80%" |- | style="{{roundy|5px}} border: 2px solid #{{normal color dark}}; background: #{{normal color light}}; width:96px; height:96px"| [[File:Paul and Ursaring DP.png|x150px]] |- | Official artwork from
